response.justification: Candidate brings valuable geospatial and mapping domain expertise through 10+ years of GIS work and the GISCollective platform, plus proven experience with high-performance systems at Dunnhumby. However, the primary C++ requirement is significantly weak—most recent C++ work was 2014-2015—and recent career trajectory (2021-present) has shifted toward TypeScript/Node.js and web development. No Rust experience and no demonstrated knowledge of routing systems or tile processing. Worth exploring if systems-level skills transfer and if candidate can rapidly ramp up on modern C++.
strengths: Deep geospatial and mapping domain expertise with 10+ years building GIS platforms and Open Green Map applications
Proven track record building high-performance systems at scale (Dunnhumby microservices handling millions of requests/second with low-latency databases)
Strong software craftsmanship discipline with emphasis on TDD, testing, CI/CD, and mentoring others
concerns: C++ experience is dated (2014-2015 at National Instruments) and limited in scope; modern C++ is the primary job requirement
Recent career shift (2021-present) focuses on TypeScript, Node.js, and web development, indicating drift away from systems-level programming
No demonstrated experience with routing systems, navigation algorithms, traffic data integration, or routing tile generation
